data.name: Gloom Hunters
data.detailed_description:
Gloom Hunters is a strategic base-raiding game where your timing and tactics determine your success. In a world where player bases are built with defenses and automated traps, you step into the shoes of a raider intent on breaching walls, outsmarting obstacles, and looting precious resources.

Key features include:

  • Base Raids: Plan and execute attacks on player-built bases defended by traps. Every base is a new puzzle to solve.

  • Strategic Gameplay: Choose your approach wisely. Sneak past defenses and exploit weaknesses in your enemy’s base.

  • Offline Thrills: Targets don’t need to be online for you to strike. Outsmart their defenses and claim rewards at any time.

  • Progression & Rewards: Grow stronger with better base obstacles and loot. Choose the right weapons and obstacles to perfect your raiding style.

  • Competition: Rise through the ranks on the global leaderboards as you perform your raiding tactics and defensive strategies. Compete against players worldwide, outplay evolving base designs and secure your place among the best players in Gloom Hunters.

Whether you want to perfect your attack strategy or just challenge yourself against bases. Gloom Hunters delivers strategic gameplay packed with fast action and satisfying rewards.

data.short_description: Gloom Hunters is an exciting strategy game where you take on the role of a raider, attacking player-built bases defended by automated traps and defenses. Test your skills by breaching walls, avoiding traps, and looting resources, even when your target is offline.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (4th generation or better) / AMD Ryzen 3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD Radeon R9 280 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Compatible sound card
  • VR Support: No VR support
  • Additional Notes: Stable 30–60 FPS on low to medium settings.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 (8th generation or better) / AMD Ryzen 5 or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580 or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Compatible sound card
  • VR Support: No VR support
  • Additional Notes: Stable 60+ FPS on medium to high settings.

content_descriptors.notes:
Gloom Hunters includes fantasy-style combat where players attack enemy bases and defend their own using weapons and defenses. The violence is stylized and not realistic. There is no graphic gore or dismemberment.

The game does not contain any sexual content or nudity.

It may include darker or suspenseful themes common in fantasy battle settings, but it does not feature self-harm, sexual assault, drug abuse, or other explicit mature topics.
